verdict.rationale: Docs mention 'A designer shares a mockup, and the system implements it without handoffs' and a 'Design mode' that lets you select an element and describe a change, implying some support for visual-input-driven tasks, but there is no explicit documentation of attaching a marked-up/annotated screenshot as a task input or how such markup is interpreted. missing for 10: explicit screenshot/image attachment mechanism, support for markup/annotations on images, independent or hands-on confirmation of the workflow.
